LESSON: RHYTHM

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Strand: Creating and Performing
Topic 2.2: Rhythm

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Rhythm
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What constitutes rhythm in music?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. compose a four- bar rhythmic pattern in 2 4 time
2. write rhythmic patterns in 2 4 on monotone from dictation
3. appreciate rhythmic patterns created by self and others
